notes.title: Survival Vacancy Free alpha demo available now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35715978/8b589a10ca59b2f009b64b246d0fde65e2d8f028.jpg[/img][b]Hello everyone,
i am happy to announce, a free alpha demo is available now on itch.io[/b]
https://mindleak.itch.io/survival-vacancy

[b]About the Demo[/b]
This is an alpha demo it could have bugs, or incomplete info...etc, the purpose of this demo is to give the player a basic introduction to the game and to collect players feedback and support
The demo contains a very basic set of game features, Limited items, tiny map, no research, no survivors. the full version has a lot more to offer, taking care of survivor, train them, keep them alive, use their skill to increase machines efficiency, the advanced machine will require skilled people to operate them, and researching new technologies
If you like the game please consider adding it to your wishlist on steam this will help a lot,
Consider joining my discord server for feedback and reporting bugs and a chance to get your hands on an alpha full version

notes.title: V 0.8.26 New game modes
notes.content:
Several new ways to play Factory Engineer.
Now you can play in sandbox mode,choose the amount of money and research points,make your most complex automated factory,experiment the game technologies and mechanics.
There are several modes with 3 levels of difficulty
-Marathon
-Balance Target
-Performance Target
-Product Target
you will have a limited number of days to complete your objective,use your time wisely.

notes.title: V 0.8.22 New Research System
notes.content:
After listening to players suggustions,i decided to change the research system

With older research system,players found it very time consuming and difficult to maintain steady flow of research points, because they need to change thier production lines a lot, and they have to wait for hours to collect research points.

New research system will be as follows
- Items will have a fixed research value during the game "no more research points decay"
- Item research value will directky depend on item complexity,more complex means more reward.

The older research system could be added later as a seperate mode for the players who like to grind and spend time collecting hard earned research points.

[b]This update is compatible with older saved game,you dont have to start new game to try it.[/b]

Thanks for everyone who gives a feedbak to make the game more fun :)
